items.title: Venezuelan delegation led by Rodriguez in US discussing debt, energy
items.author: Marianna Parraga, Vivian Sequera
items.creator: Marianna Parraga, Vivian Sequera
items.summary: A Venezuelan delegation led by interim President Delcy Rodriguez that is taking part in the United Nations General Assembly this week began discussing energy, debt and mining issues with counterparties in the US on Monday, officials and sources said.
items.body:
A Venezuelan delegation led by interim President Delcy Rodriguez that is taking part in the United Nations General Assembly this week began discussing energy, debt and mining issues with counterparties in the US on Monday, officials and sources said.
The talks are expected to lead to the signing of agreements as part of US President Donald Trump's plans to rebuild Venezuela's key industries, according to the sources.
Rodriguez arrived in New York early on Monday with her team. It was her first trip to the US after taking office as Venezuela's interim president in January under Washington's oversight, following the capture of then President Nicolas Maduro by US forces.
The top US diplomat in Venezuela, John Barrett, received her at the airport, Venezuela's state TV said.
One of her first meetings was with Inter American Development Bank President Ilan Goldfajn. She later met International Monetary Fund Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva, and World Bank President Ajay Banga, in separate meetings, according to state TV and sources.
"Her visit will have a big focus on debt restructuring, funds and payments," one of the sources said.
Venezuela announced in May it would begin restructuring its sovereign debt and that of state oil company PDVSA, estimated by most analysts at between $150 billion and $200 billion.
Last month, legal and financial advisers launched a [USN:L6N44N0R5 TEXT:"committee"] to bring together companies with outstanding claims against Venezuela ahead of the planned restructuring. The initiative aims to coordinate creditors' participation in the process and secure representation for them in negotiations with Caracas.
The IDB is drawing up a two-year engagement plan for Venezuela focused partly on electricity and social protection, Goldfajn told Reuters. The effort includes missions to examine the nation's macroeconomic framework and data and to estimate investment needs across different sectors.
DEMOCRACY, HUMAN RIGHTS Rodriguez is scheduled to meet with UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres late in the afternoon, according to his agenda.
Foreign Affairs Minister Felix Plasencia met UK officials later, state TV images showed, without providing details.
"We discussed progress towards a democratic transition and human rights, as well as recovery and reconstruction following this year's earthquakes," said Chris Elmore, UK minister for the Americas.
Venezuelan ministers and top officials advanced in negotiations for months ahead of Rodriguez's trip to New York, where she is scheduled to meet Trump on Tuesday.
The planned meeting between Trump and Rodriguez — who was Venezuela's vice president under Maduro — will take place on the sidelines of a reception hosted by the US President, the US Ambassador to the United Nations, Mike Waltz, said during a recent press briefing call.
Venezuela's Foreign Affairs and Information ministries did not immediately reply to requests for comment.
Some Venezuela-owned buildings in New York that had been shut for years, including a consulate and the office of the country's UN mission, have recently been renovated for their reopening, according to media reports. The meeting between Rodriguez and IDB officials, where oil minister Paula Henao also was present, was at the UN mission's building.
Henao, Mining Minister Hector Silva and top officials from state oil company PDVSA participated this month in a G20 energy conference in Houston, where [USN:S0N42Y01V TEXT:"a memorandum of understanding"] was inked with US oil producer Continental Resources for an area in Venezuela's main output region, the Orinoco Belt. A separate contract was also signed granting US investment firm Heeney Capital operational and export rights for a gold mine.
Another [USN:L6N458178 TEXT:"preliminary agreement"] has been in negotiation for months with US energy major ExxonMobil , which could ultimately lead to its return to Venezuela's oilfields, sources said this month.

items.title: 日本が再び円買い介入なら円売りの好機、日銀タカ派化に懐疑的－UBS
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 日本当局が円相場を下支えするため再び介入に動けば、円を売る好機になると、UBSアセット・マネジメントのグローバル国債・為替責任者ケビン・ジャオ氏は指摘した。同氏は日本銀行による18日の利上げについて、タカ派転換を示すものではないとみている。

ジャオ氏は日本当局が今年これまでに円買い介入を実施した際に円を売っており、次のきっかけを待っている。

日銀は今回利上げに踏み切り、植田和男総裁が金融政策運営について「政策の局面が変化した」との認識を示した。ただ、今後の利上げ観測であれ市場介入であれ、円がさらに上昇するとの見方に懐疑的な投資家の姿勢を変えるにはほとんど至っていないと、ジャオ氏はインタビューで述べた。

「円安につながる基本的な政策は変わっていない」と同氏は指摘。「ドル・円は今後さらに上昇する可能性が高く、どこかの時点で当局は再び介入を実施するだろう。そうしなければ面目が立たないからだ」と続けた。

ジャオ氏はこれまで円をオーバーウエートとしていたが、7月に日本と米国が大規模な協調円買い介入に踏み切った際に円を売却した。当時、円は対ドルで1ドル＝164円前後と約40年ぶりの安値まで下落していた。

円は今月に入り、日銀が利上げペースを速めるとの観測から上昇したが、18日の利上げによる下支え効果は乏しく、再びじりじりと下落している。利上げ決定後、日本当局はレートチェックを実施した。これは円買い介入に先立って行われることが多い措置だ。

ジャオ氏は、米国の利上げによって日米の金利差が維持される可能性があることから、日銀の金融引き締めを背景とした持続的な円高について「非常に懐疑的だ」と語った。市場では日銀が6月までに最大3回追加利上げすると織り込まれている一方、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）も同期間に同じ回数の利上げを実施すると予想されている。

「FRBが利下げしていた時にドル・円は下がらなかったのだから、FRBが利上げする中でどうして大幅に下がるだろうか」と同氏は述べた。

items.title: 【欧州市況】債券、株ともに大幅上昇－原油・ガス価格低下を好感
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 21日の欧州債市場では、ドイツ10年債利回りが4カ月ぶりの大幅低下に向かっている。ホルムズ海峡を通じた原油輸送が底堅く推移していることや、米国とイランの戦争終結に向けた外交努力に対する楽観もあり、原油とガスの価格は下落している。

北海ブレント原油先物は1バレル＝100ドルを割り込んだ。同水準を下回るのは、今月9日以来。ドイツ10年債利回りは7ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）低下して3.45%となった。

フランス債はアウトパフォームし、10年物のドイツ債との利回り差を3bp縮めて101bpとした。イタリアは新発12年物グリーンボンドの発行に向け銀行団に委託した。

短期金融市場で織り込まれている欧州中央銀行（ECB）の利上げ見通しは大きく後退し、10月末までに12.5bp、年内に35bp、来年末までに81bpとなった。

株式はストックス欧州600指数が2カ月余りで最大の上げ。原油・ガス価格の下落でインフレ懸念が後退したほか、今週の米中首脳会談を巡る楽観がリスク志向を押し上げた。

同指数は1%高で引け、7月2日以来の大幅上昇。銀行株の上昇が目立ち、フランスのソシエテ・ジェネラルは1.8%高。利益見通しを上方修正し、配当金を引き上げる計画も発表した。

一方、デンマークの製薬大手ノボノルディスクは7.7%安。今後数年間に5つを超える大型薬を発売し、新たに230億ドル（約3兆6100億円）超の売上高を生み出す方針を示したものの、より具体的な材料を求めていた投資家の失望売りに見舞われた。

items.title: OpenAI calls for US to take lead in global efforts to develop technical standards
items.author: Michelle Nichols
items.creator: Michelle Nichols
items.summary: Artificial intelligence giant OpenAI called on Monday for the United States to lead an international effort to develop global technical standards for frontier AI, including recursive self-improvement, where systems can autonomously enhance their own capabilities.
items.body:
Artificial intelligence giant OpenAI called on Monday for the United States to lead an international effort to develop global technical standards for frontier AI , including recursive self-improvement, where systems can autonomously enhance their own capabilities.
AI will be a key topic of discussion at the high-level UN General Assembly this week after several AI industry leaders — including OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman — called for a coordinated slowdown of the development of the [USN:L6N45A0PY TEXT:"increasingly powerful technology"], warning it could soon improve on its own and slip beyond human control.
In a blog post published as world leaders gather at the United Nations, OpenAI said it was essential that a mechanism to facilitate complementary national and international frontier standards be developed, along with common measurements and incident reporting protocols for better collective action.
"Leading now will determine whether the United States shapes the global AI framework or watches a fragmented, uneven, and conflict-ridden system take hold around it. This will also determine whether advanced AI strengthens the networks that the United States and its allies already have; failing to lead may weaken them," OpenAI wrote in Monday's blog post.
Given worries about AI potentially harming humans in the future, the industry has been talking about intentionally slowing development, or "pacing".
"Pacing AI development is not about maintaining a predetermined speed. Technically, it is about ensuring that alignment research and deployment of that research stay ahead of capabilities," OpenAI said. Alignment ensures AI acts in line with human values.
UN SECURITY COUNCIL TO MEET [USN:L6N45A15J TEXT:"Altman is due to brief"] the 15-member UN Security Council on Wednesday on AI and international security. The meeting has been convened by France, which is the president of the body for September, and will be chaired by French Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs Jean-Noël Barrot.
The UN Security Council, which is charged with maintaining international peace and security, met for the first time on the risks of artificial intelligence in 2023, when China said the technology should not become a "runaway horse" and the United States warned against its use to censor or repress people.
US President Donald Trump's administration has rejected calls to slow down AI development, wary that any pause would only hand China room to close the gap in a technology it views as central to national and economic security.
Trump said earlier this month that the US already has guardrails in place to regulate AI development, adding that China would benefit from the doubt being cast on AI development. Trump is [USN:L8N45A068 TEXT:"scheduled to meet"] with Chinese President Xi Jinping this week in Washington.

items.title: Jarvis Cocker remembers Pulp's first time in new documentary
items.author: Shaurya Thapa
items.creator: Shaurya Thapa
items.summary: Almost half a century after their birth, Britpop darlings Pulp are stars of a documentary that delves back into the band's roots in the childhood dreams of gangly frontman Jarvis Cocker.
items.body:
Almost half a century after their birth, Britpop darlings Pulp are stars of a documentary that delves back into the band's roots in the childhood dreams of gangly frontman Jarvis Cocker.
In "Pulp: What Do You Do For An Encore?" Cocker narrates flashbacks based on diary entries he scrawled out at school in the northern English city of Sheffield in the 1970s, mapping out his "masterplan" for Pulp's success.
"I was maybe 12 or 13 ... I couldn't play the guitar yet but I could write," Cocker told Reuters. "It was ... wish fulfilment. I suppose like manifesting."
He got his friends to rehearse at his mother's house, bribing them by "buying some lager".
The film, directed by "Son of Rambow"'s Garth Jennings, moves on to his time studying film and fine art in London — at the "St Martin's College" immortalised in their future hit "Common People".
"I graduated but ... what really I felt a pull to do was to write songs," he added. "I think that's my way of trying to make sense of the world and out of myself."
Pulp struggled to find success in the 1980s, then rose to mainstream success in the 1990s with albums such as "His 'N' Hers" and the Mercury Prize-winning "Different Class" and a string of other hits from "Do You Remember The First Time?" to "Disco 2000" to "Help the Aged".
After a 24-year-long recording hiatus, they returned in 2025 with the Mercury Prize-nominated "More". The film captures the band’s performances from their reunion shows at London’s O2 Arena.
As for the future, "I think I won't be alive ... in 24 years, or if I am, I won't be up to it," Cocker said.
"But, we did an album. It went well ... Everybody is still talking to each other, so I would really hope that we will make something else. But I don't know how long that will take."
"Pulp: What Do You Do For An Encore?" begins streaming on MUBI on September 25.

items.title: Thousands of US flights snarled due to FAA telecom problem
items.author: David Shepardson
items.creator: David Shepardson
items.summary: A failed telecommunications circuit and a severed fiber-optic cable snarled thousands of flights across the US on Monday and forced a halt to incoming flights at major airports in New York, Boston and Philadelphia.
items.body:
A failed telecommunications circuit and a severed fiber-optic cable snarled thousands of flights across the US on Monday and forced a halt to incoming flights at major airports in New York, Boston and Philadelphia.
The flights were halted on the day that 130 world leaders and dozens of ministers were arriving in New York for the annual high-level meeting of the United Nations General Assembly.
The Federal Aviation Administration halted incoming traffic on Monday at busy US East Coast airports and at one point stopped incoming flights at all three major New York-area airports as well as Philadelphia and Boston and two smaller airports in the New York area.
FlightAware, a flight-tracking website, said more than 5,600 US flights were delayed or canceled, including 1,200 flights at the three New York-area airports.
The issue also forced the diversion of more than 100 flights to other airports.
The incident demonstrated the fragility of the aging U.S. air traffic control system, which Congress awarded $12.5 billion for upgrades last year.
Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said an Amtrak construction crew accidentally cut into a fiber line in New Jersey which caused a telecom outage and forced FAA to pause flights in the Northeast.
He said flights were resuming at New York LaGuardia but remained paused at Newark and New Jersey's Teterboro Airport.
All arriving flights were again halted in Philadelphia after a ground stop was briefly lifted. Reagan Washington National Airport also halted flights for more than an hour because of volume issues.
FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford said a replacement circuit had failed at Philadelphia Terminal Radar Approach Control, which was the primary communications for the center. A ground stop at Boston, which stopped accepting flights because of spillover volume, was also lifted.
The FAA will not restart the system for incoming flights at the affected airports "until we make sure the airspace is safe," Bedford said.
The loss of communications was tied to a failed circuit a Philadelphia air traffic control facility that handles air traffic for the airports, Bedford said. Then authorities discovered that a backup fiber line was accidentally cut by a construction crew in New Jersey.
"When it went to flip into the backup, we discovered that the backup fiber had a break, and that fiber break is probably 13 hours to repair. It's massive, I'm told. Meanwhile, we've got the new circuit ready to install now," Bedford said.
Newark is a major United Airlines (UAL.O) hub, while Philadelphia is an American Airlines (AAL.O) hub.
Verizon said its fiber cable running adjacent to an Amtrak rail line in New Jersey was cut and its facilities were fully functional up to that point. The company said it was working to repair the damaged cable and restore connectivity as quickly as possible.
In May 2025, the Philadelphia facility that guides air traffic in and out of Newark airport suffered a series of significant communications outages.
The FAA said last year a telecommunications outage impacted communications and radar displays at Philadelphia TRACON.
Last year, Congress approved $12.5 billion to address the aging air traffic control system, and boost controller hiring following decades of complaints over airport congestion and flight delays and a series of technology issues in recent years.
Duffy said Congress needed to approve another $17.5 billion to finish the job. "This is unacceptable in America," Duffy said.

items.title: フーシ派、紅海沿岸の遮断へ要衝掌握狙う　米は直前に攻撃中止の報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [リヤド／ドバイ ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[リヤド／ドバイ ２１日 ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は２１日、サウジアラビアが支援する軍隊が支配する残存地域を紅海沿岸から切り離すため、戦略的要衝の高地の確保に向けて攻勢を強めた。トランプ米大統領がフーシ派に対する米軍の攻撃を土壇場で中止したとの報道が出た直後の動きとなる。 

今月に入って親イラン組織であるフーシ派が電撃的に進軍したことで、中東紛争は新たな戦線に拡大し、世界のエネルギー供給が一段と脅かされている。米政府はこれまで、イエメンでの戦闘に加わるようサウジアラビアのムハンマド・ビン・サルマン皇太子から繰り返し求められてきたが、これを拒んできた。

ニューヨーク・タイムズ紙は、トランプ政権がサウジ皇太子から改めて要請を受け、２０日にフーシ派への空爆を実施する準備を整えていたと報じた。ただ同紙によると、部隊が航空機に爆弾を積み込んでいる最中に、トランプ氏は土壇場で空爆を中止したという。

ロイターは同紙の報道を直ちに確認できていない。米軍中央軍は質問をホワイトハウスに委ねた。ホワイトハウスはコメントを求めるメールに直ちに回答しなかった。

トランプ米大統領は、イエメンのアリーミー大統領と２０日に電話会談を行い、世界の重要な海上交通路周辺でフーシ派が勢力を拡大している状況について協議した。ただ関係筋によると、トランプ氏は直接的な支援の約束はしなかった。

items.title: China's GAC looks to add car production capacity in Europe
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Guangzhou Automobile Group aims to add production capacity in Europe to bolster its planned large-scale roll-out of cars in major markets like France, GAC France's deputy chief executive, Cedric Lacour, said on Monday.
items.body:
Guangzhou Automobile Group (601238.SS) aims to add production capacity in Europe to bolster its planned large-scale roll-out of cars in major markets like France, GAC France's deputy chief executive, Cedric Lacour, said on Monday.
The Chinese auto maker's partner, Magna (MG.TO) , currently produces the vehicles sold in Europe, where GAC has also expanded to Finland, Greece, Poland, Portugal, Spain and the United Kingdom.
"We are currently looking into production capacity in Europe, both with Magna and with other investors," Lacour told Reuters on the sidelines of an event in Paris where GAC unveiled the compact EVs Aion UT and Aion V, its first two cars for the French market.
"We really want to establish a long-term presence here (in Europe), which automatically means we need production capacity," he said.
GAC plans to have launched 12 electric and hybrid models in France by 2030, Lacour said during a presentation, adding the auto maker also plans to operate 50 dealerships in France this year, rising to 200 by 2030.
"Our goal is to take a brand from launch to scaling up in just four years," he said.
Asked if GAC, founded in 1997, was late and trailing some rivals in coming to Europe, Lacour said it was "entering the market at just the right time".
In July and August, EVs reached record shares of new car registrations of 35% and 38% in France, boosted by higher fuel prices linked to the Iran war.

items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 21日の米国株式市場で、半導体株が軒並み高。メタ・プラットフォームズの新たなAIエージェントが好調な滑り出しを見せ、AIを支える半導体株への期待が高まった。

アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（AMD）株は約10%高となり、時価総額は初めて1兆ドル（約157兆円）を超えて取引を終えた。インテル株は12%、ソフトバンク傘下のアーム・ホールディングス株は17%それぞれ急伸した。フィラデルフィア半導体株指数（SOX）は4.3%上昇し、5営業日続伸となった。

メタ株価は11%高。トランプ米大統領が市場を揺るがしていた関税措置の90日間停止を発表し、株価が急伸した2025年4月以来の大幅上昇を記録した。

半導体株への楽観論が再び高まった背景には、アップルのアプリ配信サービス「アップストア」の無料アプリランキングで、メタ・プラットフォームズが今月投入した「Muse AI Agent（ミューズAIエージェント）」が首位に躍進したことがある。

これを受け、エージェント型AIを動かすのに必要な中央演算処理装置（CPU）メーカーの株式に再び買いが殺到した。

ブルームバーグが集計したデータによると、メタはAMDにとって第2位の顧客で、売上高の約5.5%を占める。

ウェドブッシュのアナリスト、マシュー・ブライソン氏は「エージェント型AIは、大量の計算処理を必要とするアプリケーションに依存している」と指摘。「こうした計算処理を担うのは実質的にインテルとAMDの2社だ」と述べた。

メタは今月、買い物や映画チケットの購入、予約の手配といったさまざまな作業を利用者に代わってこなすAIエージェントのMuseを投入した。一方、アマゾン・ドット・コムは20日夜から、Museによる通販サイトへのアクセスを遮断した。

AMD株を巡っては、ここ数週間に再び投資家の関心が高まっている。AIトレードの先行きや投資回収への懸念を背景に2カ月にわたり下落していたが、9月に入ってからは約30%上昇。月間で5月以来の大幅高となる見通しだ。6月の高値から7月の安値までは約26%下落していた。

items.title: Grail rallies as FDA staff flags no major concerns for multi-cancer test
items.author: Christy Santhosh, Padmanabhan Ananthan
items.creator: Christy Santhosh, Padmanabhan Ananthan
items.summary: The US FDA's staff reviewers did not raise major concerns about the accuracy and safety of Grail's blood test designed to detect more than 50 cancers, sending the company's shares soaring 35% on Monday.
items.body:
The US FDA's staff reviewers did not raise major concerns about the accuracy and safety of Grail's (GRAL.O) blood test designed to detect more than 50 cancers, sending the company's shares soaring 35% on Monday.
The findings on the screening test, called Galleri, will be discussed at the FDA's external advisers' meeting on Wednesday to review Grail's request for premarket approval.
The FDA has no outstanding questions for the external panel on analytical performance, study design and the primary safety analyses of Galleri, according to the briefing documents.
But the agency asked the advisers to discuss whether the evidence supports Galleri's characterization as an "early detection" test.
"We view this as constructive for Grail," said Piper Sandler analyst David Westenberg, adding that he expects a favorable vote.
Grail's shares have plunged more than 20% since February after it said routine screening with the test [USN:L4N3ZG0RF TEXT:"failed"] to significantly boost early detection and reduce late-stage diagnoses in a pivotal three-year UK trial.
The company had filed for the Food and Drug Administration's approval in January based on data from a smaller US trial, first-year data from the UK trial and a bridging analysis comparing data from an earlier version of the test.
Galleri and Abbott Laboratories' (ABT.N) multi-cancer blood test, Cancerguard, are already available on the market under the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments regulations, but neither is FDA-approved.
An FDA approval ensures widespread distribution, adoption of guidelines for physicians and routine health insurance coverage.
Multi-cancer early detection tests analyze molecular signals shed by tumors into the bloodstream from a single blood draw.
Galleri is meant to complement, not replace, established screenings such as mammograms and colonoscopies, Grail has said.
The test brought in revenue of $136.8 million in the US in 2025.
items.raw_description: The US FDA's staff reviewers did not raise major concerns about the accuracy and safety of Grail's blood test designed to detect more than 50 cancers, sending the company's shares soaring 35% on Monday.

items.title: Lula diz que Uruguai cedeu ao Brasil parte da cota de carne para China; efeito seria limitado em 2026
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva afirmou nesta segunda-feira que o Uruguai cedeu ao Brasil parte da cota de exportação de carne bovina do país para a China, uma vez que os frigoríficos brasileiros já completaram a cota nacional de embarques em 2026 ao país asiático.
items.body:
O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva afirmou nesta segunda-feira que o Uruguai cedeu ao Brasil parte da cota de exportação de carne bovina do país para a China, uma vez que os frigoríficos brasileiros já completaram a cota nacional de embarques em 2026 ao país asiático.
"Agradeci a autorização concedida ao Brasil para uso do excedente da cota uruguaia de exportação de carne bovina para a China", disse Lula, em uma publicação no X.
O Ministério de Relações Exteriores do Uruguai não comentou o assunto imediatamente.
A postagem de Lula no X foi feita após um encontro bilateral com o presidente do Uruguai, Yamandú Orsi, em Nova York, no contexto da Assembleia Geral da ONU que ocorre nesta semana.
"Tratamos de temas da agenda bilateral, em especial infraestrutura e comércio agrícola", acrescentou Lula.
A associação de empresas do setor de carnes Abiec afirmou que "avalia como positiva toda iniciativa que possa ampliar o acesso da carne bovina brasileira ao mercado chinês".
"Neste momento, porém, um eventual aproveitamento do excedente da cota uruguaia teria efeito limitado em 2026, considerando o tempo necessário para negociação, embarque e trânsito da mercadoria até a China", afirmou a Abiec em nota.
Enquanto o Brasil já completou sua cota com tarifa mais baixa de 1,1 milhão de toneladas para 2026, o Uruguai ainda teria volumes disponíveis para este ano. Os volumes, no entanto, não estão claros e a negociação ainda precisaria de um aval da China, que passou a taxar em 55% os volumes extracota.
Conforme notou a Abiec, já em novembro o Brasil começa a embarcar produto para a China para completar sua própria cota de 2027, o que tornaria limitada a utilização do remanescente da cota uruguaia de 2026 pelos frigoríficos brasileiros.
"Para 2027, a medida pode representar uma alternativa importante, especialmente diante da cota brasileira de 1,128 milhão de toneladas e do risco de seu esgotamento já nos primeiros meses do ano, caso se mantenha o atual ritmo de vendas", acrescentou a Abiec.
Uma antecipação de embarques de carne bovina do Brasil para a China, para o cumprimento da cota de 2027, pode levar ao [USN:L1N4590LY TEXT:"preenchimento"] rápido dos volumes totais de 1,128 milhão de toneladas estabelecidos para o ano, avaliou o presidente da Abiec, Roberto Perosa, na semana passada.
Por isso, a Abiec reiterou que defende previsibilidade e mecanismos que permitam distribuir melhor os embarques ao longo do ano, "preservando o fluxo comercial com o principal destino da carne bovina brasileira".

items.title: Newsom signs bill limiting investor influence in California law firms
items.author: David Thomas
items.creator: David Thomas
items.summary: California, one of the largest US legal markets, has joined Colorado and Illinois in enacting legislation to limit investor influence in law firms amid surging interest in deals that allow outside capital to fuel lawyers' business.
items.body:
California, one of the largest US legal markets, has joined Colorado and [USN:L6N4470UV TEXT:"Illinois"] in enacting legislation to limit investor influence in law firms amid surging interest in deals that allow outside capital to fuel lawyers' business.
California Governor Gavin Newsom on Sunday signed legislation prohibiting business entities from interfering or attempting to "influence the professional judgment of a licensed attorney or litigant regarding any substantive litigation decision," including lawyers' settlement decisions and what cases and clients they take. Violators, including attorney recipients of outside capital, face statutory damages of $10,000 per violation, or three times the damages suffered by a client.
California Assembly member Ash Kalra, who authored AB 2305, did not immediately respond to a request for comment. In a statement last month, Kalra said, "The principle is simple: when you hire a lawyer, the person making decisions about your case should be your lawyer — not a private equity entity looking for profit."
Consumer Attorneys of California, a trade group that backed the legislation, said in a statement Monday that the state is "setting the standard for the rest of the country to follow."
Investors and other non-lawyers are broadly prohibited in the United States from owning direct stakes in law firms or sharing in attorney fees. However, a growing number of firms are inking deals to spin off their non-legal, back-office operations like human resources or marketing into a separate organization called a management services organization (MSO), that is owned or partly owned by outside investors.
Such deals can provide an influx of capital for a law firm, which pays the MSO from its revenues but does not share fees.
Some MSOs serve multiple firms. California's new law applies to business entities that raise or manage capital and are involved in litigation practice "no matter how it is legally structured, labeled, organized, or operated."
Trisha Rich, a partner at Holland & Knight whose team has closed more than 30 legal industry MSO deals this year, told Reuters the California law does not "change a single thing," since existing attorney professional rules already guard against outside influence on legal decision-making.
She said the similar laws in Illinois and Colorado had not affected MSO deal-making in those states, and that there had been no enforcement efforts tied to the provisions.
Newsom last year [USN:L2N3VV010 TEXT:"signed into law a bill"] that prohibited attorneys in the state from splitting fees with out-of-state "alternative business structures," unless there is a contract stating that the fees will be shared, as well as other conditions.

items.title: Mercados financieros de Argentina operan mixtos, comitiva FMI visita el país para revisión programa
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La plaza financiera argentina cerró mayormente mixta el lunes, con una marcada reducción de negocios, en momentos en que los inversores centran su atención en la visita de una misión del Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) para la tercera revisión del programa de 20.000 millones de dólares con el país.
items.body:
La plaza financiera argentina cerró mayormente mixta el lunes, con una marcada reducción de negocios, en momentos en que los inversores centran su atención en la visita de una misión del Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) para la tercera revisión del programa de 20.000 millones de dólares con el país.
"Una nueva misión del FMI en Argentina comienza hoy para llevar a cabo la tercera revisión del programa, que determinaría si Argentina recibe un nuevo desembolso de 870 millones de dólares por parte del organismo", dijo la consultora Max Capital.
Fuentes del Ministerio de Economía consultadas por Reuters no hicieron declaraciones sobre la visita de los funcionarios del organismo.
El FMI declaró recientemente que la tercera economía de América Latina debe seguir [USN:L1N4520OO TEXT:"fortaleciendo sus reservas"], reducir riesgos financieros y mantener el ancla fiscal.
Con el fin de reforzar sus arcas, el banco central argentino (BCRA) mantiene compras de divisas en el mercado cambiario pero a un ritmo menor al de meses previos, según operadores.
En lo que va de septiembre, la entidad monetaria acumula adquisiciones de divisas por unos 211 millones de dólares, luego de que en agosto sumara compras por unos 770 millones de dólares. En el año totaliza unos 14.295 millones de dólares.
La consultora Portfolio Personal Inversiones (PPI) acotó que "la liquidación del agro en septiembre sería la mayor para este mes (...). Entonces, si el agro está vendiendo a este ritmo y el BCRA compra tan poco, ¿quién se lleva la diferencia?. El resto de los sectores representa una demanda neta de unos 154 millones de dólares por rueda en lo que va del mes".
"En consecuencia, el BCRA ha tenido que ajustar significativamente sus compras para que el tipo de cambio se mantenga prácticamente inalterado", remarcó PPI.
El peso argentino en la plaza interbancaria se apreció apenas un leve 0,03% a 1.514,5 unidades por dólar para la venta al cierre.
Por su parte, el índice líder S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires perdió un 0,76% al final de sus negocios, tras queda la semana previa con una merma de un 2,48%.
Fuentes financieras señalaron que la reducción de operaciones en los mercados argentinos estuvo afectada por la celebración del "Yom Kippur", una fecha de gran relevancia en el calendario judío que provoca la ausencia de operadores y ahorristas.
Los bonos en el segmento extrabursátil mejoraron un 0,5% promedio y el riesgo país se ubicaba en 531 puntos básicos (2000 GMT), similar a lo marcado un mes atrás.

items.title: グーグル、初の高級AIラップトップ投入－Geminiとの連携を売りに
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米アルファベット傘下のグーグルは、初投入する「Googlebook（グーグルブック）」の価格とハードウエア仕様を発表した。AI機能の搭載が標準となりつつある高級ラップトップPC市場に参入する。

価格は899ドル（約14万1600円）から。基本ソフト（OS）「Android（アンドロイド）」のユーザーやプログラマーを取り込み、対話型AI「Gemini（ジェミニ）」との連携を売りにしたい考えだ。

エイサー、華碩電脳（エイスース）、デル・テクノロジーズ、HP、レノボ・グループの5社が製造を担当する。

価格やデザイン、プロセッサー、ストレージなどの仕様は異なるが、キーボード配列は似ており、バッテリー残量などを表示する「Glowbar（グローバー）」を共通して備える。

広告とサービスを主な収益源とするグーグルにとって、高級ラップトップ市場への参入の狙いは、Androidスマートフォンとスムーズに連携し、「実際に役立つ」AI機能を備えた製品を提供することにある。Androidエコシステムを統括するサミール・サマット社長が先週、ニューヨークで開かれた報道向けイベントで説明した。

「現在の仕事のやり方は、ラップトップでの利用に必ずしも最適化されていない」と、サマット氏は発表前のインタビューで語った。「スマートフォンで仕事を始めてラップトップに移ったり、その逆だったりする人が増えている」とし、異なるプラットフォーム間でアプリの連携が十分でない点を指摘。「今の時代や将来の利用の仕方に合うよう、ラップトップを刷新したかった」と述べた。

Googlebookは13－15インチのタッチスクリーンを搭載し、バッテリー駆動時間は最長14時間をうたう。発売時には、インテルの「Core Ultra Series 3」プロセッサーか、クアルコムの「Snapdragon X」チップを搭載し、将来はメディアテック製半導体も採用する予定だ。薄型・携帯性を重視し、一部モデルは重さがわずか2.2ポンド（約1キロ）となる。予約受け付けは21日に始まり、米国では10月4日に出荷を開始する。翌5日にはカナダ、英国、アイルランド、フランス、ドイツ、オーストラリアでも発売する。

items.title: 日米韓外相がＮＹで会談、台湾支持を表明　米中首脳会談控え共同声明
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Simon Lewis　David Brunnstrom

[ニューヨーク ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Simon Lewis　David Brunnstrom

[ニューヨーク ２１日 ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は２１日、ニューヨークで茂木敏充外相、韓国の趙顕外相と会談し、日韓というアジアの主要同盟国の防衛に対する揺るぎない関与を改めて表明した。トランプ米大統領と中国の習近平国家主席の会談を週内に控え、３カ国外相は台湾への支持も表明した。 

日米韓は外相会談後に共同声明を発表。中国を念頭に置いたとみられる形で「経済的威圧や非市場的な政策・慣行」のほか、「サプライチェーンを混乱させる恣意的な輸出規制」に対抗していく姿勢を表明した。

共同声明は、米国は「核能力を含む比類のない軍事力に裏打ちされた日韓の防衛に対する揺るぎない関与を改めて表明する」とし、「日韓に対する拡大抑止を再確認する」としたほか、強固な安全保障協力へのコミットメントと、台湾海峡の平和と安定を維持する重要性を強調し、「台湾の適切な国際機関への意義ある参加を支持する」と表明した。

北朝鮮については「完全な非核化に向けた断固たるコミットメントを再確認する」とした上で、対話の再開を呼びかけた。

このほか、サプライチェーン強化や重要技術分野での協力拡大に向けた幅広い取り組みの一環として、新たな経済安全保障に関する３カ国の協議メカニズムの発足を歓迎するとした。

ルビオ長官は会談に先立ち、茂木外相、趙外相と写真撮影に応じたが、記者団の質問には答えなかった。

トランプ大統領は２４日にワシントンのホワイトハウスで習主席と会談する。アナリストは、トランプ大統領が中国との交渉で経済面での成果を得るために、台湾問題や貿易問題を巡って習氏に譲歩する可能性があるとの懸念が高まっていると指摘。関係筋によると、日本の高市早苗首相と韓国の李在明大統領は、ニューヨークで開かれる国連総会に出席するのに合わせ、トランプ大統領との会談を望んでいる。

items.title: 銀行の信用格付け、AI活用の成否が重要に－戦略・ガバナンスが鍵
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： S&Pグローバル・レーティングスは、銀行によるAIの活用が信用格付けに及ぼす影響が、今後数年間で一段と大きくなるとの見方を示した。AI戦略の成熟度とガバナンス体制の強さが、金融機関の明暗を分ける。

S&Pは21日の報告書で「導入のペースやガバナンスの成熟度、運用面での準備状況にはばらつきがあり、今後数年間、AIは金融機関の信用力を強める、あるいは弱める要因として、ますます重要になるだろう」と指摘した。

S&Pが6月に世界の金融機関約179社を対象に実施した調査では、AIによるコスト削減効果は今年最大4%に達し、2028年までに6－8%に拡大すると見込まれている。現時点では約84%が、支援業務や自動化にAIを活用していると回答。一方、規制上のリスクや評判リスクを背景に、新製品・サービスの開発にAIを活用しているとの回答は3分の1未満にとどまった。

AI研究・導入担当責任者のミリアム・フェルナンデス氏は電子メールで、「信用力への最終的な影響を左右するのは、AIを導入しているかどうかではなく、金融機関が健全なリスク管理を維持しながら、こうしたコスト効率化や追加収益を収益性の持続的な改善につなげ、同業他社に対する競争優位を生み出せるかどうかだ」と述べた。

原題：AI Use Will Soon Influence Banks’ Credit Ratings, S&P Says

items.title: 急落した英国債の一部銘柄がひそかな人気、トレーダーらも個人で購入
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ロンドンのバンカーは、急落した英国債を個人口座で買い進めている。中でも人気を集めているのが、2028年1月償還債だ。

バークレイズのデータによると、8月に個人投資家が最も多く購入した英国債が、この債券だった。英国最大の個人向け投資プラットフォーム、ハーグリーブス・ランズダウンでも同債が最も人気となるなど、熱狂が見られている。英国債全体の購入も過去2週間で約50%増加したという。

2028年1月債は、あまり見られない極めて有利な特徴を併せ持っている。税金がかかるのは0.125%という低いクーポンの利息だけで、リターンの大部分は、満期に向けて価格が額面に近づくことで生じる非課税のキャピタルゲインだ。一方、残存期間が短いため、地政学リスクへのエクスポージャーも抑えられる。

この組み合わせはトレーディングフロアで話題を呼び、ブルームバーグ・ニュースが話を聞いた十数人が、自分自身または同僚が購入していると答えた。

ウェルズ・ファーゴのストラテジスト、マーカス・ジェニングス氏は、「類似する他の債券に比べて割高で、需要の強さを示している。低クーポンであることが理由だろう」と述べた。「低クーポンの英国債は、リターンがキャピタルゲインに偏る」と指摘した。

低クーポンの英国債は近年、英国人富裕層の間で人気が高まっている。英国債のキャピタルゲインは課税されないという税制上の優遇措置により、預金口座よりも税引き後の実質的なリターンが高くなる可能性があるためだ。

ブルームバーグがまとめたデータによると、こうした傾向はここ数カ月で加速し、2028年債でとりわけ顕著だ。同債は現在、最も近い年限の英国債に対して68ベーシスポイント（bp）割高な水準で取引されている。

ナインティー・ワンのポートフォリオマネジャー、ジェイソン・ボルボラシーン氏は「高金利の銀行預金口座に現金を預ける代わりの選択肢、というだけのことだ。英短期債の利回りは大半の債券と同様にまずまず上昇していた。2028年償還債は、所得税上の優遇措置の恩恵を受けられる低クーポン債の中で、次に満期を迎える銘柄だ」と語った。

items.title: Presidenta venezolana viaja a EEUU para hablar de energía, deuda y minería: fuentes
items.author: Marianna Parraga, Vivian Sequera
items.creator: Marianna Parraga, Vivian Sequera
items.summary: Una delegación venezolana encabezada por la presidenta interina Delcy Rodríguez, que participa esta semana en la Asamblea General de las Naciones Unidas, comenzó el lunes a discutir asuntos de energía, deuda y minería con sus contrapartes en Estados Unidos, según informaron funcionarios y fuentes.
items.body:
Una delegación venezolana encabezada por la presidenta interina Delcy Rodríguez, que participa esta semana en la Asamblea General de las Naciones Unidas, comenzó el lunes a discutir asuntos de energía, deuda y minería con sus contrapartes en Estados Unidos, según informaron funcionarios y fuentes.
Se espera que las conversaciones lleven a la firma de acuerdos como parte de los planes del presidente estadounidense Donald Trump para reconstruir las industrias clave del país sudamericano, señalaron las fuentes.
Rodríguez llegó a Nueva York a primera hora del lunes junto a su equipo. Es su primer viaje a Estados Unidos tras asumir la presidencia encargada en enero -bajo supervisión estadounidense-, después de la captura del entonces presidente Nicolás Maduro por parte de las fuerzas estadounidenses.
El máximo representante diplomático de Estados Unidos en Venezuela, John Barrett, la recibió en Nueva York, según la televisión estatal venezolana.
Tras varias citas matutinas, por la tarde Rodríguez se reunió con la directora gerente del Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI), Kristalina Georgieva, mostró la televisora estatal venezolana, pero no hubo declaraciones.
A mediados de julio, [USN:L6N43K006 TEXT:"Venezuela accedió a 346 millones de dólares "]de sus propios recursos a través del Fondo para ayudar en la recuperación tras los terremotos que azotaron el país a finales de junio, según anunció entonces la presidenta encargada. También se prevé que Rodríguez se encuentre este lunes con delegados del Banco Mundial, según dos fuentes.
Hay otros citas previstas como con el PNUD, que ha sido clave en la asistencia al país tras los sismos de junio.
Una de sus primeras reuniones fue con el presidente del Banco Interamericano de Desarrollo (BID), Ilan Goldfajn. Más tarde, el canciller venezolano, Félix Plasencia, se reunió con funcionarios del Reino Unido, según mostraron imágenes de la televisión estatal, aunque no se ofrecieron detalles al respecto.
"Analizamos los avances hacia una transición democrática y en materia de derechos humanos, así como la recuperación y reconstrucción tras los terremotos de este año", dijo el ministro británico para las Américas, Chris Elmore, en su cuenta de X con una foto junto al ministro venezolano.
Está previsto que Rodríguez se reúna con el secretario general de la ONU, António Guterres, a última hora de la tarde, según la agenda del funcionario.
El [USN:L6N45D0UW TEXT:"BID está elaborando un plan"] de colaboración de dos años para Venezuela, centrado en parte en el sector eléctrico y la protección social, declaró Goldfajn a Reuters el lunes. La iniciativa incluye misiones para examinar el marco macroeconómico y los datos del país, así como para estimar las necesidades de inversión en diversos sectores.
Ministros y altos funcionarios venezolanos han estado avanzando en negociaciones durante meses, preparando el terreno para el viaje de Rodríguez. Está previsto que se reúna con Trump este martes.
El encuentro entre Trump y Rodríguez, quien fue vicepresidenta de Venezuela bajo el mandato de Maduro, tendrá lugar durante una recepción ofrecida por el presidente estadounidense, dijo el embajador de Estados Unidos ante las Naciones Unidas, Mike Waltz, durante una reciente conferencia de prensa.
Los ministerios de Asuntos Exteriores e Información de Venezuela no respondieron de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios.
Algunos edificios propiedad de Venezuela en Nueva York, incluidos un consulado y la oficina de la misión del país ante la ONU, han sido renovados recientemente para su reapertura tras haber permanecido cerrados durante años, según medios locales.
La reunión entre Rodríguez y los funcionarios del BID, en la que también estuvo presente la ministra de Hidrocarburos, Paula Henao, se celebró en el edificio de la misión ante la ONU.
Henao y el ministro de Desarrollo Minero Ecológico, Héctor Silva; y altos funcionarios de la empresa estatal PDVSA participaron a principios de este mes en la conferencia de energía del G20 en Houston, donde se firmó un memorando de entendimiento con la petrolera estadounidense Continental Resources para un área en la principal región de producción de Venezuela: la Faja del Orinoco.
Desde hace meses se negocia otro acuerdo preliminar con la gran petrolera ExxonMobil, el cual podría desembocar finalmente en su regreso a los yacimientos petrolíferos de Venezuela, según informaron fuentes este mes.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［フランクフルト　２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［フランクフルト　２１日　ロイター］ - ドイツ連邦銀行（中央銀行）は２１日公表した月報で、イラン情勢に伴うエネルギー高騰や、医療関連の制度変更を要因として、ドイツのインフレ率が「当分の間は高止まりする」との見通しを示した。医薬品の供給ルール変更や医療制度改革により、２０２７年前半にはインフレ率が一時的に０．５％ポイント近く押し上げられると指摘した。

高止まりする燃料や石油関連商品や低水準にとどまるガス在庫といったインフレ要因が他の分野に波及するリスクについても言及した。

２６年７─９月期のドイツ経済は、輸出や消費の低迷、干ばつが影響してわずかな伸びに留まるものの、年内には回復に向かうとの見通しを示した。

ドイツでは、生活費の高騰や経済の停滞に対する有権者の不満が高まり、重要な政治課題となっている。８月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は、欧州連合（ＥＵ）基準（ＨＩＣＰ）で前年同月比２．９％上昇した。

２６年１０─１２月期は回復が見込まれるとの見通しは維持した。製造業の景況感の改善や公共事業による建設業の下支えを要因として挙げつつ「中東情勢の展開や、主要水路の水位がいつ回復するかにも左右される」との見解を示した。

items.title: CNN, Politico et MS NOW contestent devant la justice leur bannissement de la Maison blanche
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: CNN, MS NOW et Politico ont poursuivi lundi le président Donald Trump et d'autres membres de son administration après leur bannissement de l'enceinte de la Maison blanche, estimant que cette mesure violait leurs droits à la liberté d'expression et à la liberté de la presse garantis par le premier amendement de la Constitution américaine.
items.body:
CNN, MS NOW et Politico ont poursuivi lundi le président Donald Trump et d'autres membres de son administration après leur bannissement de l'enceinte de la Maison blanche, estimant que cette mesure violait leurs droits à la liberté d'expression et à la liberté de la presse garantis par le premier amendement de la Constitution américaine.
Les médias demandent à un tribunal fédéral de Washington de rendre une ordonnance restrictive temporaire pour bloquer la décision de Donald Trump, et des audiences d'urgence pourraient se tenir dès cette semaine.
"Sans préavis ni procédure, la Maison blanche a révoqué les accréditations de nos journalistes parce qu'elle désapprouve nos reportages. Si rien n'est fait pour contester cette décision, cela menace la liberté de la presse et le droit du public à un journalisme indépendant, à l'abri de toute ingérence gouvernementale", ont écrit les trois organisations dans un communiqué commun.
Donald Trump a annoncé cette interdiction vendredi sur les réseaux sociaux, affirmant que ces médias "ne devraient pas pouvoir constamment écrire ou rapporter des FICTIONS et des MENSONGES lorsqu'ils couvrent le président des Etats-Unis", avant de défendre sa décision dans une nouvelle publication lundi.
"La Maison blanche ne mène pas une offensive contre la presse libre, à laquelle je suis très attaché. Elle mène une offensive contre les FAUSSES INFORMATIONS", écrit-il.
"C'est un phénomène corrompu, délibéré, omniprésent, parfaitement coordonné et totalement hors de contrôle. C'est une menace pour notre sécurité nationale, et il faut y mettre un terme, MAINTENANT !"
Les présidents américains ont déjà eu des relations conflictuelles avec la presse, mais la campagne de Donald Trump contre les médias est sans précédent.
Il a bouleversé des décennies de tradition en privant de nombreux grands organes de presse d'un accès élémentaire, en lançant des attaques personnelles contre des journalistes à propos de leur travail et en favorisant des médias considérés comme plus favorables à son administration. Il a également engagé des poursuites contre plusieurs organes de presse.
CNN est l'un des cinq médias, avec ABC, CBS, Fox News et NBC, constituant le principal "pool" télévisé de la Maison blanche. Selon le principe du "pool", ils partagent le coût de la couverture du président, organisent celle-ci à tour de rôle et mettent leurs images à la disposition de médias dans tout le pays.
CNN devait assurer lundi la couverture en pool du déplacement de Donald Trump à New York pour l'Assemblée générale des Nations unies, mais n'a pas été en mesure de fournir les images.
En réaction, toutes les autres grandes chaînes de télévision ont suspendu la couverture présidentielle en "pool".
Cette décision a de fait supprimé la principale source d'images des événements de la Maison blanche alors que Donald Trump doit rencontrer de nombreux dirigeants mondiaux en marge de l'Assemblée générale et recevoir le président chinois Xi Jinping à Washington plus tard dans la semaine.
"Nous vous informons qu'à compter d'aujourd'hui (lundi), le pool télévisé ne couvrira plus les événements du président désignés comme relevant de la couverture en pool", a déclaré lundi dans un courriel Bryan Boughton, qui dirige le bureau de Fox News à Washington et préside actuellement le pool télévisé.
"Aucun pool de remplacement ne sera mis en place."

items.title: Mayoría de monedas sube en medio expectativa Oriente Medio y baja precios crudo
items.author: Manuel Farías
items.creator: Manuel Farías
items.summary: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subieron el lunes, con la expectativa de avances diplomáticos entre Estados Unidos e Irán que además provocaban una caída en los precios del petróleo, lo que aliviaba las preocupaciones sobre la inflación.
items.body:
La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subieron el lunes, con la expectativa de avances diplomáticos entre Estados Unidos e Irán que además provocaban una caída en los precios del petróleo, lo que aliviaba las preocupaciones sobre la inflación.
* Las bolsa de la región, en tanto, fueron respaldadas por el alza de Wall Street, donde el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) cerró en un máximo histórico.
* Teherán y Washington volvieron a intercambiar amenazas el domingo, pero el presidente Donald Trump dijo que estaría dispuesto a reunirse con su par iraní, Masoud Pezeshkian, quien se espera que esté en Nueva York esta semana con motivo de la Asamblea General de Naciones Unidas.
* Los precios del crudo referencial Brent retrocedieron con fuerza y en un punto de la sesión cotizaron por debajo de los 100 dólares el barril por primera vez desde el 9 de septiembre. Perdieron un 3,4% a 100,34 dólares.
* El presidente de la Reserva Federal de Chicago, Austan Goolsbee, afirmó que está abierto a la posibilidad de que la inflación comience a descender hasta el objetivo del 2%, pero que, si eso no ocurre, será necesario subir las tasas de interés.
* Mientras, el jefe de la Fed de San Luis, Alberto Musalem, dijo a Reuters que es probable que el banco central tenga que subir aún más las tasas de interés para reducir la inflación derivada de la fuerte demanda, así como de un choque de los precios de las materias primas que ha ido más allá del petróleo. Añadió que sería mejor que el banco central actuara cuanto antes en lugar de esperar.
* La Fed aumentó el costo del crédito a un rango del 3,75%-4% la semana pasada.
* El peso mexicano cotizaba por la tarde sin cambios, a 17,2243 unidades por dólar, tras avanzar más temprano, con la mirada puesta en la decisión de Banco de México sobre política monetaria. El índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, revertía una leve baja de más temprano y sumaba hacia el cierre un 0,25%, a 63.535 puntos.
* "Esperamos que Banco de México mantenga su tasa de referencia en 6,50% en su decisión del jueves. La inflación subyacente sigue siendo persistente y el aumento de 25 puntos base de la [USN:L1N4580T6 TEXT:"Reserva Federal"] estadounidense este mes ha reducido el diferencial de tasas entre México y EEUU, lo que refuerza la cautela", dijo en una nota Phanteon.
* El real brasileño sumó un 0,72% a 5,1080 por dólar la venta, mientras los inversores analizaban una nueva encuesta electoral de cara a las presidenciales del próximo mes; al tiempo que el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) ganó preliminarmente un 0,82% a 186.752 puntos, respaldado por el avance de los mercados externos.
* El peso argentino interbancario se apreció un leve 0,03% a 1.514,5 unidades por dólar para la venta, tras una apertura negativa. Por su parte, el índice líder S&P Merval (.MERV) de la Bolsa de Buenos Aires perdió un 0,76%, tras finalizar la semana previa con una merma de un 2,48%.
* La atención de los inversores se centra en la visita de una misión del Fondo Monetario Internacional para la tercera revisión del programa de 20.000 millones de dólares con el país.
* El peso colombiano cerró con caída de un 0,68% a 3.199 unidades por dólar, completando seis jornadas consecutivas de pérdidas; mientras que en la bolsa el índice accionario MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) , avanzó un 0,68%, a 2.565 puntos.
* El peso chileno , se fortaleció un 1,29%, a 947,20/947,50 unidades por dólar, impulsado por el retroceso global del billete verde y un avance en los precios del cobre, la mayor exportación del país, tras el feriado local del viernes. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , cayó un 0,21%, a 11.357,82 puntos.
* Los precios del cobre subieron el lunes por quinta sesión consecutiva, acercándose a máximos históricos, ya que las expectativas de un repunte estacional de la demanda en China, el mayor consumidor mundial, mantenían las compras especulativas.
* La moneda peruana, el sol , se apreció un 0,15% a 3,3550/3,3560 unidades por dólar. En tanto que la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) escaló un 1,05%, a 1.576 puntos.

items.title: Tata Capital growth outlook stays positive despite near-term headwinds
items.author: Devangshu Datta
items.summary: Retail and SME momentum supports Tata Capital's 23-25 per cent growth guidance, though funding costs, high crude prices and proposed RBI rules remain key risks.
items.body: At Tata Capital’s recent analyst meet, management remained confident of its 23-25 per cent growth guidance, given momentum in Retail and SME (small & medium enterprises) exposures and expectations of a recovery in Commercial Vehicles (CVs). The combination of Retail and SME should account for 85-87 per cent of the portfolio, while wholesale moderates to 13-15 per cent. The mix should shift further towards Retail and SME from the third quarter of financial year 2026-27 (Q3FY27). Asset quality is comfortable for the Tata group-owned non-banking financial company (NBFC), with no signs of early stress. But sustained high crude oil prices are an area of concern. There is pressure on NIM (net interest margin), but a strategy of targeting higher yields should support recovery from the second half (H2) of FY27. Margins will be under pressure in Q2 due to rising cost of funds. Lower FCNR(B) deposit rates are yet to translate into lower borrowing costs for NBFCs. Tata Capital has increased its repo-linked borrowing, while roughly 66 per cent of assets are at floating-rate. Management thinks the economy can absorb around 50-75 basis points (bps) of rate increases without much impact on growth, and it does not envisage a sustained high-rate environment. The proposed Reserve Bank of India (RBI) framework on revolving credit and flexi loans is an important monitorable. The draft amendment directions seek to restrict NBFCs from offering revolving credit. Management has given detailed inputs to the RBI with a key regulatory concern being the liquidity risk of borrowers drawing their entire sanctioned limits during periods of stressed liquidity. Other stakeholders have also given inputs to the RBI.  The company said around 80 per cent of its customers using such facilities do not have similar limits from banks and that ticket sizes are generally small. LAS (loans against security) and supply-chain or channel financing constitute around 95 per cent of the flexi exposure, and could be more difficult to restructure if the framework is revised. Management expects the final regulation to change materially from the current draft. Around 8-9 per cent of Tata Capital's overall book falls under the broad flexi or revolving category. But less than 5 per cent of this exposure is a true revolving line, with the balance more like a term loan and thus, relatively easier to convert into conventional term-loan structure. The FIDC (Finance Industry Development Council) is still collecting additional data and feedback, particularly from smaller NBFCs. The high FCNR inflows have improved system liquidity but not translated into meaningful reduction in NBFC funding costs so far. There hasn’t been a clear pass-through of lower FCNR funding costs from banks to NBFCs. Short-term funding costs, including commercial paper (CP) rates, have hardened recently. There is a possibility of higher rates going forward. Banks being flush with funds could get aggressive. Tata Capital had increased its reliance on repo-linked liabilities and benefited during the rate-cut cycle. Around 66 per cent of assets are floating rate. Bank borrowings account for 40 per cent of liabilities, of which around 84-85 per cent are linked to repo or Gsec rates. Going forward, lower funding costs could see banks become more aggressive in home loans and large corporate lending, increasing competitive intensity. The company is increasing the mix of higher-yielding products, with home loans also to be added from the next quarter. The benefits of this strategy are expected to become visible from Q3 and Q4. Credit costs have positive trends with guidance of less than 1 per cent, despite the higher-yielding mix for a potential 5-10 bps increase in credit costs. Management remains confident of achieving its growth guidance, as volume is healthy across Retail and SME, while Corporate and SME customers are also providing visibility. The trend is positive on two-wheeler financing, and passenger vehicle (PV) demand is also healthy. The CV segment is expected to break even in Q3 and return to growth thereafter. There is no apparent cause for concern on asset quality but high crude oil prices remain a near-term risk, for SME and CV. Management may reassess the approach towards SME lending soon if crude oil stays elevated, and motor finance could require higher provisioning. Tata Capital has limited exposure to information technology (IT), with only 4 per cent of channel-finance exposure. The company is assessing the potential impact of GenAI. Tata Capital will not pursue large inorganic opportunities given the constraints such transactions could create on the borrowing side. The strategic preference is to push growth organically across Retail, SME, etc. Apart from the guidance of 23-25 per cent growth, and credit costs and net NPAs (non-performing assets) being held at below 1 per cent, the company is looking at cost-to-income ratio of 33-34 per cent and believes it can deliver return on assets (RoA) of 2.5-2.7 per cent for a return on equity (RoE) of 17-18 per cent. According to Bloomberg, seven of the eight analysts polled this month are bullish, while one is neutral. Their average one-year target price is ~414, compared to Monday’s closing price of ~343.55 on the BSE.

items.title: パラマウント、ＷＢＤ買収巡り12州と和解　買収完了へ前進
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jody Godoy　Deborah Mary Sophia

[２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Jody Godoy　Deborah Mary Sophia

[２１日 ロイター] - 米メディア大手パラマウント・スカイダンス＜PSKY.O＞によるワーナー・ブラザース・ディスカバリー（ＷＢＤ）の買収を巡り、パラマウントは買収阻止を求めて提訴していたカリフォルニア州を含む１２州と和解した。和解条件には米国内での映画製作を拡大することが盛り込まれた。カリフォルニア州のボンタ司法長官が２１日、明らかにした。これにより、買収実現に向けた大きな法的障害が取り除かれた。

ボンタ長官は記者会見で、国内での映画製作支出を年間少なくとも３億ドル上積みするほか、買収完了後は年間の映画製作本数を段階的に増やすことで合意したと明らかにした。具体的には、買収後の最初の２年間は年間３０本、その後の３年間は年間３２本の映画を製作する。このうち毎年少なくとも４本はインディペンデント映画とし、少なくとも２０％を大作映画とする必要がある。

また和解条件に基づき、パラマウントはＣＢＳおよびＣＮＮの報道における編集上の独立性を確保するため、「報道編集独立委員会（ニュース・エディトリアル・インディペンデンス・ボード）」を設置する。

２１日午後の米国株式市場でパラマウント・スカイダンスは約８％、ＷＢＤは約１０％上昇している。

items.title: Wall Street sube con fuerza por optimismo por la IA y baja de los rendimientos
items.author: Johann Cherian, Noel Randewich
items.creator: Johann Cherian, Noel Randewich
items.summary: El S&P 500 y el Nasdaq cerraron el lunes con fuertes subidas, por las alzas de Advanced Micro Devices y otras grandes empresas del sector de la inteligencia artificial, mientras que los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro retrocedieron desde máximos recientes y los precios del petróleo se desplomaron a un mínimo de 11 días por especulaciones de un avance en las negociaciones sobre Oriente Medio.
items.body:
El S&P 500 y el Nasdaq cerraron el lunes con fuertes subidas, por las alzas de Advanced Micro Devices y otras grandes empresas del sector de la inteligencia artificial, mientras que los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro retrocedieron desde máximos recientes y los precios del petróleo se desplomaron a un mínimo de 11 días por especulaciones de un avance en las negociaciones sobre Oriente Medio.
Las acciones del sector de los chips se recuperaron, con fuertes subidas tanto de Intel (INTC.O) como de Arm Holdings .
Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) alcanzó por primera vez una capitalización bursátil de 1 billón de dólares.
Inversores mencionaron indicios que sugieren que el gasto en inteligencia artificial sigue creciendo, a pesar de las recientes advertencias sobre seguridad de los líderes de los gigantes de la IA, que desencadenaron una ola de ventas en el sector tecnológico.
El rendimiento de referencia de los bonos estadounidenses a 10 años cayó a menos del 5%, mientras que los futuros del crudo Brent bajaron de los 100 dólares por barril a un mínimo desde el 9 de septiembre, pero luego se recuperaban a 100,34 dólares por barril.
Mientras Washington y Teherán intercambiaban amenazas durante el fin de semana, el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo que estaría dispuesto a reunirse con el presidente iraní, Masoud Pezeshkian, cuya asistencia a la Asamblea General de la ONU en Nueva York está prevista para esta semana.
"Estamos, en cierto modo, programados para seguir la evolución del precio del petróleo y el rendimiento de los bonos estadounidenses a 10 años, y si nos fijamos en esos dos factores hoy, han pasado de ser factores adversos a factores favorables para este mercado, al menos a corto plazo", dijo Art Hogan, estratega jefe de mercados de B. Riley Wealth.
Las acciones de Meta (META.O) se dispararon después de que la correduría Wells Fargo elevó su precio objetivo, tras el reciente lanzamiento de Muse, su asistente de IA.
Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) subió 113,72 puntos, o un 1,49%, a 7.764,22 unidades, mientras que el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) ganó 599,55 puntos, o un 2,26%, a 27.122,09. El Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) sumó 371,24 puntos, o un 0,72%, a 52.053,88 unidades.

items.title: World Bank, IMF back changes to debt framework for poor countries
items.author: Andrea Shalal
items.creator: Andrea Shalal
items.summary: The World Bank and International Monetary Fund said on Monday that both their executive boards had approved proposed reforms of their joint framework for evaluating the debt of low-income countries to reflect a more complex and riskier environment.
items.body:
The World Bank and International Monetary Fund said on Monday that both their executive boards had approved proposed reforms of their joint framework for evaluating the debt of low-income countries to reflect a more complex and riskier environment.
A joint review, the first since 2017, recommended changes in several areas, including beefing up the analysis of domestic debt held by poor countries, and broadening consideration of long-term development challenges, including climate change. It stopped short of calling for a wholesale redesign.
The reforms are intended to refine how the IMF and World Bank measure a country's debt-carrying capacity and provide new tools to better differentiate between countries facing some risk of debt stress and those whose debt is deemed unsustainable.
The World Bank and IMF said they would also work to enhance the tools and stress tests used to ensure the consistency and accuracy of forecasts, while encouraging countries to improve reporting and transparency of their debt data. They left the discount rate used in making assessments unchanged at 5%.
"Overall, our goal is a very practical one. It is to help countries identify vulnerabilities earlier and also more precisely, so that they can make better-informed financing choices and better-informed policy choices," said Allison Holland, who worked on the new debt sustainability framework and now serves as deputy director in the IMF's African Department.
Holland said recent shocks had reversed improvements in the debt landscape seen since 2021, taking the number of countries at high risk or already in debt distress back to pre-pandemic levels.
"Around 14% of low-income countries are in debt distress, and another 33% are at high risk. About 23% of emerging market countries are at high risk of overall sovereign stress," she said.
The revised framework could help inform a debt restructuring requested earlier this month by Senegal in exchange for a $2.2 billion IMF bailout two years after a hidden debt scandal that pushed it into crisis. The IMF has said it will assess Senegal's debt sustainability using the current framework, "while taking into account the implications of the transition" to the new one.
The IMF has not provided details on how the revised framework — with consideration of domestic debt — could affect Senegal's debt restructuring.
TAKING EFFECT IN SECOND HALF OF 2027 The changes, which will become operational in the second half of 2027, should help countries better assess how much they can invest in needed development and climate adaptation measures while containing debt vulnerabilities over the long term, the IMF and World Bank said.
A review completed in July confirmed that the debt sustainability framework, first introduced in 2005, had worked well to identify debt distress episodes ahead of time and help countries make informed borrowing and lending decisions.
But it recommended changes to account for higher debt levels in many low-income countries and a shift in financing sources to include more domestic and external borrowing on commercial terms. The IMF and World Bank have a separate framework for assessing the debt sustainability of advanced and emerging market economies that will be reviewed in coming years.
The IMF said near- and medium-term economic projections that feed into the analyses had generally been reliable, but longer-term forecasts of exports and revenues had shown some "optimism bias" and left data gaps, including for state-owned enterprises.
The new framework introduces a long-term module to add granularity to risk assessments, as well as specific thresholds for overall public debt stress.
But IMF board members agreed to temporarily hold off publishing the models used to assess unsustainable debt to give time to adjust to the new methodologies. Stand-alone staff notes would be used to share data with the board for now, it said.

items.title: AI覇権争いと安全リスク－米中首脳会談､今後を左右する5つの争点とは
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ホワイトハウスで24日行われるトランプ米大統領と中国の習近平国家主席との首脳会談では、AIが主要議題の一つとなる見通しだ。米中両国はAIを新たな経済覇権争いの主戦場とみている。トランプ氏は13日、「AIを制する者が勝つ」と表明した。

両国が対立を乗り越え、安全で持続可能なAI環境の構築で協力できるかどうかが焦点となる。現時点では互いの意図を信用しておらず、どちらも開発競争のペースを落とすことは望んでいない。

米国は国家安全保障上の懸念を理由に、米国で設計された最先端AI半導体の中国向け輸出を2022年から制限している。ただ、こうした措置は想定通りに機能していないとの認識が広がっている。

米検察当局は、エヌビディア製の先端AI半導体が中国の顧客向けに密輸された疑いを巡り、大規模な捜査を複数進めてきた。最も注目された事例としては、米司法省が今年、スーパー・マイクロ・コンピューターの共同創業者ウォリー・リャオ氏を起訴した。

エヌビディアの最先端半導体を搭載した米国製サーバーを、輸出規制に違反して中国の顧客に送るのを手助けしたとされる。リャオ氏は無罪を主張しており、エヌビディアは厳格な法令順守体制を整えていると述べている。

また、中国のムーンショットAI（月之暗面）が、米国勢の最先端モデルに迫る性能を持つ大規模言語モデル「Kimi K3」を発表すると、ホワイトハウス当局者は、エヌビディア製半導体を違法に入手し、タイ経由で遠隔利用していたと非難した。中国政府はこの主張に反論している。ムーンショットはコメントしていない。

米議員らはまた、中国のAI企業が他国にある計算能力を借りることで輸出規制の抜け穴を利用しているとも主張している。超党派の法案が現在、議会で審議されており、クラウドコンピューティングを介した中国からのエヌビディア製半導体への遠隔アクセスを制限する内容となっている。商務省も、輸出管理権限を使ってこうした行為を取り締まる方策を検討している。

BRUSSELS, Sept 21 : Efforts to combat cyberattacks across the European Union are being undermined by member states' failure to share enough information on the incidents, the European Court of Auditors said on Monday. 
The 27-nation bloc was investing more and more in cybersecurity — with €1.4 billion ($1.61 billion) in its current budget — and improving cooperation, according to the court, which reports on how effectively the EU spends money.
But this was not working as well as it should, it added.
Poor information sharing was the "Achilles heel of the entire system", the report said.

"When a serious cyber incident occurs, timely and actionable information is essential. Without it, networks and mechanisms lose much of their added value," it added.
It pointed to a ransomware attack on a technology provider for the aviation industry in September 2025, which disrupted airports in London, Brussels, Berlin, Dublin and other hubs. 
None of the affected states notified the EU cybersecurity agency or other members of the incident, the report said.
Individual countries' national security legislation was getting in the way when countries needed to share information about incidents that crossed borders, the court said.
No EU state has reported a "large-scale" cybersecurity incident since 2016, even though that label officially applies to any attack affecting at least two members, it added.    
In July, the European Commission referred France, Ireland, the Netherlands and Spain to the EU Court of Justice for failing to adjust their national laws to include EU measures on sharing cybersecurity information.

Sept 21 : Alphabet's Google on Monday opened pre-orders for Googlebook, its new premium laptop category for Android users built around the company's Gemini AI tools.
Starting at $899, initial models from Acer, Asus, Dell, HP and Lenovo will run on Intel or Qualcomm processors with up to 14 hours of battery life, the company said.
The launch comes as Apple moves deeper into lower-priced laptops with its $699 MacBook Neo, adding competition in a market where Chromebook makers have long targeted students and budget-conscious consumers on affordability and simplicity.
Googlebook extends that formula into premium laptops with more powerful hardware, AI features and tighter Android integration — Google's latest push for a flagship ChromeOS showcase after the Pixelbook in 2017 and Pixelbook Go in 2019.

items.title: Paramount wins Warner Bros takeover after settling states, union lawsuits
items.author: Jody Godoy, Deborah Sophia
items.creator: Jody Godoy, Deborah Sophia
items.summary: The settlement includes the creation of independent editorial boards for CNN and CBS, and a $30 million penalty per film for any shortfall against Paramount's pledge to release 30 movies annually.
items.body:
Paramount Skydance (PSKY.O) emerged victorious on Monday from a legal battle over its $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros Discovery after settling with a California-led group of US states and a Hollywood writers union, paving the way for one of the largest media mergers in history.
The settlement marks a major win for Paramount CEO David Ellison, who battled the states for months to finalize a deal that would dramatically concentrate power across Hollywood's film, TV, streaming and news businesses.
Paramount agreed to abide by temporary film quotas and a news oversight committee, avoiding a forced sale of cable assets such as CNN or any of its lucrative film franchises.
The settlement delighted Warner Bros shareholders, but drew criticism from opponents of the merger who say it will hurt Hollywood jobs. Shares of Paramount pared back earlier gains on Monday, while Warner Bros Discovery (WBD.O) surged more than 10%.
The Writers Guild of America settled its parallel case against Paramount, while saying it still believes the deal will damage the industry. The states' settlement forced the union to "contend with the reality of forging ahead alone, with no backing from government enforcers" in a complex case that would have cost millions of dollars.
California Attorney General Rob Bonta called the settlement "a strong antitrust outcome."
"More production, more choice, and guardrails that keep this industry competitive. I don't think these two companies should merge, but that's not something that we are focused on with our resolution here," he said at a press conference in Los Angeles.
Paramount promised in the state settlement to bring more film production to the US — spending at least $300 million more each year in domestic production — and adhere to US theatrical release quotas for five years.
The company will produce 30 movies in each of the first two years of the deal, and 32 movies in each of the following three years, Bonta said. Each year, at least four of those films must be independent films and at least 20% must be blockbusters. If it falls below that threshold, it will pay $30 million per film, most of it into funds to support workers.
Paramount also promised not to raise rates on theater operators for three years.
Under the settlement terms, Paramount will establish a news editorial independence board to ensure independence at the CBS and CNN networks.
Reuters [USN:L6N45A19I TEXT:"first reported"] on Friday that Paramount and the states could settle as soon as the weekend.
Ellison thanked the states and California Governor Gavin Newsom for his support throughout the process.
"Our goal has always been to build a stronger Hollywood — one with more stories told, greater choice for consumers and stronger competition," he said in a statement.
While Trump administration regulators cleared the deal, a coalition of 12 state attorneys general, led by California's Bonta, [USN:L6N43C0UE TEXT:"sued in July"] to block the merger, arguing it would reduce competition and create a media behemoth with the power to raise prices in movies and television.
The [USN:L6N43G1C1 TEXT:"Writers Guild"] also sued to stop the deal, arguing it would decrease pay and worsen working conditions for film and TV writers.
The companies said earlier this year the merger will mean $6 billion in savings, through moves including cost cuts that would likely affect jobs across Hollywood as well as in the CNN and CBS newsrooms. The combined company is expected to hold $80 billion in debt.
The settlement helps Paramount avoid a $7 million-a-day "ticking fee" it would have owed Warner shareholders for each day the deal does not close past September 30.
Antitrust regulators in other jurisdictions globally, including the European Union and Britain, have already cleared the deal.

BENGALURU: Google said on Monday (Sep 21) it has agreed to report content flagged as child sexual abuse material to Indian authorities, breaking from a global practice under which such reports are first routed through a US non-profit.
The decision follows a similar announcement by Meta last week. It comes after two Indian government sources told Reuters they had in recent weeks pressed tech companies like Google and Microsoft to report child abuse content concerning India directly, given concerns that the existing system delays reports significantly.
A Google spokesperson said the company "invests significantly to detect, deter, remove, and report child sexual abuse material", and described the proposal as part of the company's "ongoing discussions with the government of India".
India is the largest market by users for both Meta's Facebook and Google's YouTube, and Meta's own shift followed weeks of friction with the Indian government, including an apology last month by CEO Mark Zuckerberg over the spread of child sexual abuse material on the company's platforms.

Meta and Alphabet's Google have for years made such reports to the US-based National Center for Missing & Exploited Children, which then relays reports to law enforcement in the country involved.
Indian officials had argued to tech platforms that the arrangement costs precious time in cases where a child may be in active danger, since reports pass through that intermediary before reaching domestic police who can act on the ground, according to two sources.
Child sexual abuse material remains a vast and growing global problem. The CyberTipline, run by that same nonprofit, received more than 21.3 million reports from around the world of suspected child sexual exploitation in 2025.
Technology and law enforcement officials in the United States, the European Union and elsewhere have pushed platforms to speed up detection and reporting, though most countries continue to route reports through the US nonprofit as the primary international clearing house.

items.title: Cameco may turn $2.1B into $24B with Westinghouse listing
items.author: Northern Miner Staff
items.creator: Northern Miner Staff
items.summary: Westinghouse Electric's investment may soon soar 12x as it gears up for a U.S. stock market listing.
items.body:
Cameco may turn $2.1B into $24B with Westinghouse listing

Colin McClelland | September 21, 2026 | 7:42 am
Energy   Markets   Canada   USA   Uranium  

An AP1000 reactor under construction. Credit: Westinghouse Electric.

Cameco’s (TSX: CCO)(NYSE: CCJ) $2.1-billion investment in Westinghouse Electric three years ago could soon be valued a dozen times that as the nuclear reactor maker prepares for a US stock market listing.

Westinghouse is seeking a valuation above $50 billion and could publicly file for an initial public offering as soon as October, Bloomberg News reported Friday. Cameco owns 49% of the company, implying a value above $24.5 billion for its holding before accounting for shares sold in the offering or potential dilution.

“A potential IPO comes a lot sooner than we previously envisioned,” Scotiabank analyst Orest Wowkodaw said after Cameco’s second-quarter results last month. “We have increased our medium- to long-term Westinghouse estimates.”

The proposed valuation would mark a dramatic re-rating even from analysts’ estimates last month. Desjardins valued Cameco’s share of Westinghouse at C$15.1 billion, while Scotiabank valued the entire reactor company at C$24.6 billion, putting Cameco’s 49% interest at about C$12 billion.

Cameco and Brookfield Renewable Partners (TSX: BEP.UN; NYSE: BEP), along with institutional investors, completed the acquisition in November 2023. The deal valued Westinghouse at $8.2 billion including debt after closing adjustments. Cameco paid $2.1 billion for its 49% interest, using $1.5 billion in cash and $600 million in term loans.

Reactor pipeline

The potential jump in value comes as Westinghouse builds a much larger pipeline for new reactor work than when Cameco bought into the company.

Westinghouse has identified opportunities for as many as 91 AP1000 reactors over more than 20 years, Cameco said in July. The pipeline includes as many as 20 US reactors under government programs, two units at the stalled V.C. Summer project in South Carolina, three in Poland, two each in Bulgaria and Ukraine and dozens of earlier-stage prospects.

Cameco also raised its estimate of the share of construction spending that could flow to Westinghouse on new AP1000 projects to 40% to 45%. Scotiabank estimated that could translate into $8 billion to $11 billion of Westinghouse revenue over roughly a decade for a two-reactor project and $1.6 billion to $2.2 billion of earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization.

The higher revenue share was a positive for Westinghouse over the medium term, BMO analyst Alexander Pearce said in August. Firm commitments for new AP1000 reactors remained more important in the near term than the timing of an IPO, he added.

The distinction matters because the 91 reactors represent a pipeline of opportunities rather than firm orders. A $50-billion-plus valuation would partly depend on investors assigning value today to projects that could stretch well into the 2030s.

Washington is trying to shorten that timeline. The U.S. Department of Energy in June made a conditional commitment for as much as $17.5 billion in financing for long-lead equipment for up to 10 AP1000 reactors. Westinghouse would work with utilities and energy companies on as many as five two-reactor projects, with the program intended to bring construction and commercial operation forward by as much as three years.

Government interest

The $24.5-billion figure doesn’t mean Cameco could simply pocket that amount in an IPO.

Westinghouse hasn’t disclosed how many shares would be offered, whether Cameco or Brookfield would sell existing holdings or how much new stock might be issued. It submitted a confidential draft filing to U.S. securities regulators July 31.

A separate agreement with Washington could also dilute the existing owners under certain conditions.

Cameco and Brookfield agreed last year on a strategic partnership under which the U.S. government would receive a participation interest if it makes a final investment decision and enters definitive agreements for at least $80 billion of new Westinghouse reactor construction in the U.S. before January 2029. Once vested, the interest would entitle Washington to 20% of Westinghouse cash distributions above $17.5 billion.

If the interest has vested and an IPO values Westinghouse at $30 billion or more, the government could require a listing. The interest would then be converted into a five-year warrant to buy shares equivalent to 20% of the public value above $17.5 billion.

Desjardins was more cautious than Scotiabank on timing, saying in July that the IPO window remained broad and could extend as far as 2029.

Cash returns

A listing could also sharpen questions over how Cameco uses rising cash flow.

Scotiabank forecasts Cameco’s free cash flow rising to C$1.3 billion in 2028 from about C$200 million this year. With the miner already holding a small net cash position, Wowkodaw said the bank anticipates “further improvements to dividends ahead.”

Cameco raised its annual dividend to 24¢ a share from 16¢ last year. The company’s strong balance sheet, improving free cash flow and limited internal need for capital should make shareholder returns an increasingly frequent discussion, Scotiabank said.

The uranium side of Cameco’s business could add another tailwind. Nuclear demand is beginning to outrun new mine supply, with Benchmark Mineral Intelligence forecasting a uranium shortfall equal to 18% of demand by 2027. Global reactor requirements could rise from about 64,500 tonnes uranium annually to as much as 143,900 tonnes by 2050, according to the OECD Nuclear Energy Agency and the International Atomic Energy Agency.

Much of the recent supply increase has come from restarting or expanding existing operations rather than developing new mines, which typically take 15 to 20 years from exploration through production.

Cameco shares rose 1.5% to C$130.02 in Toronto on Monday morning, valuing the Saskatoon-based company at about C$56.6 billion ($40.3 billion).

items.title: ブレント原油、6月以来の連続安へ－イラン巡る外交努力に期待高まる
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 原油価格は1バレル＝100ドル近くまで下落し、6月以来最長の連続安となる勢いだ。ホルムズ海峡を通じた堅調な原油輸送や、米国とイランの戦争終結に向けた外交努力を受け、上昇相場が落ち着きつつある。

ロンドン時間21日午後3時半現在、ブレント原油は3.77%安の1バレル＝100.1ドルで取引されている。

トランプ米大統領はFOXニュースに対し、今週ニューヨークで開かれる国連総会に合わせ、イランのペゼシュキアン大統領との会談の可能性を「恐らく」排除しない考えを示した。トランプ氏は中国の習近平国家主席との首脳会談も予定し、湾岸諸国の首脳らと会談する可能性もある。

衛星データによると、サウジアラビアではペルシャ湾内からの原油積み出しが週末に急増し、同国のペルシャ湾側の主要港で確認された船舶数が6月以来最多となった。今月、紅海につながる主要な東西横断パイプラインが停止したことを受け、サウジアラビアは原油輸送を再びホルムズ海峡経由に切り替えている。

米中央軍によると、過去2週間にホルムズ海峡を通過した原油と液化天然ガス（LNG）の輸送量は、6カ月ぶりの高水準となっている。域内で軍と商船の連絡を担う英国海運貿易オペレーション（UKMTO）によると、17－19日には米国の支援を受けながら、1日当たり約32隻がホルムズ海峡を通過した。

A/Sグローバル・リスク・マネジメントのチーフアナリスト、アルネ・ローマン・ラスムセン氏は「原油にかかっていた最も強い上昇圧力は和らぎつつある可能性がある。焦点は、ホルムズ海峡を通じた原油とLNGの輸送改善や、ニューヨークでの国連総会に合わせて外交面で進展する可能性に移っている」と述べた。

items.title: ＡＭＤ時価総額が1兆ドル突破、米半導体メーカーで4社目
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２１日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイシズ（ＡＭＤ）の株価が２１日午前の米国株式市場で上昇し、時価総額が初めて１兆ドル台に乗せた。米半導体メーカーとして時価総額が１兆ドルを突破したのは、エヌビディア、ブロードコム、マイクロン・テクノロジーに次いで４社目。

人工知能（ＡＩ）向けコンピューティング分野での役割拡大への期待から買いが集まっており、株価は一時前営業日終値比９．６％高の６１３．５０ドルに上昇し、過去最高値を更新した。

ＡＭＤはＡＩ関連製品の投入を加速させており、個々の半導体の販売にとどまらず、プロセッサーやネットワーク機器、関連ハードウエアを組み合わせた完全なシステムを提供することで、エヌビディアに対抗している。

また、推論処理を行うサーバーでＧＰＵ（画像処理半導体）と併用されるＣＰＵ（中央演算処理装置）の需要拡大も、インテルから市場シェアを奪う一因となっている。

２１日はほとんどの半導体銘柄が急騰し、インテルは約１２．８％、クアルコムは８．２％、それぞれ上昇した。グレートヒル・キャピタルの会長、トーマス・ヘイズ氏は「資金が再びＡＩ関連銘柄に戻ってきている」と指摘した。
